import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_5.csv"
]

# Columns of the target schema (and source schemas)
target_columns = [
    'S/N',
    'Building/Project Name',
    'Street Name',
    'Postal District',
    'Type',
    'No. of Bedroom(for Non-Landed Only)',
    'Monthly Gross Rent($)',
    'Floor Area (sq ft)',
    'Lease Commencement Date'
]

# Function to load and preprocess each source file
def load_and_preprocess(filepath):
    # Load CSV with first column as index (to ignore it)
    df = pd.read_csv(filepath, index_col=0)
    
    # Rename 'Floor Area (sq ft)' column if needed (some sources have 'Floor Area (sq ft)' with a space difference)
    # According to the prompt, all sources have the same schema, so no rename needed.
    # But just in case, unify column names by stripping spaces:
    df.columns = [col.strip() for col in df.columns]
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target_columns (order and names)
    # If any column is missing or extra, reorder and select only target columns
    df = df[target_columns]
    
    # Data type conversions to match target schema:
    # 'S/N': integer
    df['S/N'] = pd.to_numeric(df['S/N'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # 'Postal District': integer
    df['Postal District'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Postal District'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # 'Monthly Gross Rent($)': integer
    df['Monthly Gross Rent($)'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Monthly Gross Rent($)'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # 'No. of Bedroom(for Non-Landed Only)': string (some have 'na*' or numbers)
    # Convert all to string, keep as is
    df['No. of Bedroom(for Non-Landed Only)'] = df['No. of Bedroom(for Non-Landed Only)'].astype(str)
    
    # 'Building/Project Name', 'Street Name', 'Type', 'Floor Area (sq ft)', 'Lease Commencement Date' are strings
    # Convert to string and strip spaces
    for col in ['Building/Project Name', 'Street Name', 'Type', 'Floor Area (sq ft)', 'Lease Commencement Date']:
        df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()
    
    return df

# Load all source dataframes
dfs = [load_and_preprocess(fp) for fp in source_files]

# Operation History: UNION all source tables
# Concatenate all dataframes vertically
Target5_17 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
Target5_17.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
df5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/training_5.csv", index_col=0)

# Union all source tables (concatenate)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4, df5], ignore_index=True)

# Convert 'Monthly Gross Rent($)' to numeric (integer), coercing errors to NaN
df['Monthly Gross Rent($)'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Monthly Gross Rent($)'], errors='coerce')

# Group by all columns except 'Monthly Gross Rent($)' and aggregate by max on 'Monthly Gross Rent($)'
group_cols = ['S/N', 'Building/Project Name', 'Street Name', 'Postal District', 'Type',
              'No. of Bedroom(for Non-Landed Only)', 'Floor Area (sq ft)', 'Lease Commencement Date']

df_grouped = df.groupby(group_cols, dropna=False, as_index=False).agg({'Monthly Gross Rent($)': 'max'})

# Ensure data types match target schema
df_grouped['S/N'] = df_grouped['S/N'].astype(int)
df_grouped['Postal District'] = df_grouped['Postal District'].astype(int)
df_grouped['Monthly Gross Rent($)'] = df_grouped['Monthly Gross Rent($)'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Write the final output CSV with exact column names and no index
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_17/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
